title: Garage place
what: Garage as a place of this machine: its buckets and objects browsed, read and changed over S3 with the configured profile, its data folders guarded, in src/files/garage.rs.

title: Node road
what: The node machines as places: the node list from bmo-node, each reached by an SSH or jake hub road running a POSIX or PowerShell script for drives, listing, reading and changes, in src/files/node/.

title: File share links
what: Share links to a file or folder kept in the service's store with their span, the holder's page and download routes, and the bmo-drive file share command, in src/files/shares.rs and src/command.rs.

title: File viewer
what: The file routes: places and machines, this machine's drives and volumes, listing in natural order, ranged reading, folder, upload, rename, copy and delete behind the protected-location guard, and folder zips, in src/files/.
